description: This file contains internal class implementations of grains with generic interfaces for testing purposes in an Orleans-based project. It defines classes that implement generic grain interfaces with different type parameters, including methods for setting, transforming, and retrieving internal state, as well as comparing grain references.

classes.name: ConcreteGrainWithGenericInterfaceOfIntFloat
classes.description: Implements IGenericGrain with int and float type parameters, providing methods to set and map the internal value.

classes.name: ConcreteGrainWithGenericInterfaceOfFloatString
classes.description: Implements IGenericGrain with float and string type parameters, providing methods to set and convert the internal value.

classes.name: ConcreteGrainWith2GenericInterfaces
classes.description: Implements both IGenericGrain and ISimpleGenericGrain interfaces with int and string types, providing methods for setting, transforming, retrieving, and comparing grain references.

methods.name: SetT
methods.description: Sets the internal value T with the provided parameter.

methods.name: MapT2U
methods.description: Maps the internal value T to another type, returning a Task with the result.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the internal value T with the provided parameter, delegating to SetT.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms the internal value T by multiplying it by 10.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of T.

methods.name: CompareGrainReferences
methods.description: Method intended to compare grain references, currently not implemented.
